rows.text: Column 'Proposed Pathway' is my first-draft grouping — edit any cell in this column to reassign a strand to a different pathway.
Just type the pathway name you want (e.g. 'Algebra & Equations') directly over my draft, or leave blank to mark 'undecided'.
Each grade cell shows: Topic name (number of subtopics extracted). '(0)' means no subtopic list exists in the source for that cell — a real gap in the sheet, not an extraction error.
G11 has no subtopic data anywhere in the source file (topic name only) — confirmed while cross-checking, not something to try to recover.
- Functions  (not yet assigned to specific strands below — flag which ones you want pulled into it)
- Financial Literacy (optional 8th pathway? strands HH, OO are financial-literacy-flavored)
Once you send this back, I'll rebuild the roadmap data object using your corrected mapping.
